name: v1.24.0
body:
## Significant Changes
* New `skopeo copy` options `--remove-list-signatures` and `--strip-removed-platforms`

## What's Changed
* Bump Skopeo to v1.23.0, common 0.68.0, image 5.40.0, storage 1.63.0 by @TomSweeneyRedHat in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2881
* CI migration by @mtrmac in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2883
* ci: switch self-hosted runners from Oracle to CNCF Ubuntu by @timcoding1988 in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2887
* [skip-ci] Update actions/checkout action to v6.0.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2891
* [CI]: pull skopeo_cidev image from ghcr instead of quay by @timcoding1988 in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2888
* Update module golang.org/x/term to v0.44.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2893
* A few small man page fixes by @mtrmac in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2895
* Update actions/checkout action to v7 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2897
* Update actions/setup-go action to v6.5.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2901
* Fix minor grammar error in skopeo.1.md by @NateEag in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2903
* docs: include examples for --command-timeout duration format by @Rolv-Apneseth in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2902
* Update dorny/paths-filter action to v4.0.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2904
* Update module golang.org/x/net to v0.55.0 [SECURITY] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2907
* Update module golang.org/x/crypto to v0.52.0 [SECURITY] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2906
* Update module github.com/containers/ocicrypt to v1.3.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2905
* Use `go.yaml.in/yaml/v3` instead of `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` by @mtrmac in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2908
* Update module golang.org/x/term to v0.45.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2909
* Add support for manifest list signature removal and sparse manifest list stripping by @aguidirh in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2892
* Update module go.podman.io/common to v0.68.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2910
* ci: make the automation release renovate managed by @Luap99 in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2911
* Update dependency podman-container-tools/automation to v20260707 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2920
* Update actions/setup-go action to v7 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2921
* fix issue_pr_lock.yml workflow and do not run cronjobs at midnight by @Luap99 in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2925
* Update actions/checkout action to v7.0.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2926
* Update module github.com/containers/ocicrypt to v1.3.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2927
* Update dependency podman-container-tools/automation to v20260722 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2929
* integration: use our own pause image by @Luap99 in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2935
* Update module go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 to v3.0.5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2934
* ci: drop redundant make vendor from test_skopeo by @vtushar06 in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2932
* Update actions/stale action to v11 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2937

## New Contributors
* @NateEag made their first contribution in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2903
* @Rolv-Apneseth made their first contribution in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2902
* @vtushar06 made their first contribution in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/pull/2932

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/compare/v1.23.0...v1.24.0
